topic: Parts and Functions of the Ear
key_concepts: Pinna is the visible outer ear that collects sound waves
Ear canal is the passage of sound to the eardrum
Eardrum is a thin piece of skin that vibrates when sound reaches it
Hammer, anvil, and stirrup are three small bones that vibrate when the eardrum vibrates
Cochlea is a snail-like part filled with liquid that sends messages to the auditory nerve
Auditory nerve tells the brain the sounds we hear
Sound travels from pinna to ear canal to eardrum to small bones to cochlea to auditory ner
Use a clean cloth in wiping the outer ear
Have a doctor check the ears for any problem
Avoid listening to loud music and inserting sharp objects in the ear
Consult a doctor whenever there is an ear problem or sudden loss of hearing
Never put anything inside the ear
